style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: the signature one-sided curl — only one corner of the mouth lifts, the eyes look down their nose at the target (the 'raised chin, lowered gaze' combination unique to contempt, anatomically opposite of looking up at someone with respect)
expression_signature.brows: the inner end of the brow on the side she is curling toward lifts slightly while the other brow stays flat — creates an asymmetric arch that reads as disdain
expression_signature.mouth: one corner lifted into a smirk that does not reach the eyes, lips closed, the lifted corner tighter than the other — a controlled, almost-amused sneer
expression_signature.cheeks: no flush, no tear, completely composed — this is the coldest face in the wife's repertoire
expression_signature.head: slightly tilted back and to one side, chin raised high, looking down the nose — physical superiority posture
expression_signature.overall_impression: the face of a woman who has decided the man across from her is beneath her — used on Page 6 ('你凶我干嘛呀'), Page 13 ('人也能瞧得上你哪一块啊, 娶到我, 你算是烧高香了'), the coldest pages of the story

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: as in base-v1 — fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top + light grey high-waisted yoga leggings (or going-out outfit if applicable)
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: spine straight, weight on back foot, head tilted back — body language of looking down on someone

micro_motion.static: standing over the seated husband, one hand on hip, head tilted back
micro_motion.subtle_motion: a single low 'tch' exhale through the smirk; eyes flick briefly to husband's hands / phone / pillow before returning to his face; one manicured finger flicks dismissively outward

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: warm tungsten lamp from a low angle lighting her from below the chin — slight horror-movie underlighting that emphasizes the smirk's coldness
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: any flattering soft light — this face should read as cold and clinical
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.narrative_pairing: over husband's seated shoulder, or low-angle shot of her standing over him

voice_lines_examples: 娶到我，你算是烧高香了
人也看不上你，你是有钱还是有人
prompt_snippet_en: cold contempt expression, signature one-sided mouth curl with only one corner lifted into a smirk that does not reach the eyes, eyes looking down their nose at the target (the raised-chin lowered-gaze combination unique to contempt), the inner end of the brow on the curl side lifted slightly while the other brow stays flat creating an asymmetric disdain arch, mouth closed with the lifted corner tighter than the other, controlled almost-amused sneer, no flush no tear completely composed cheeks, head slightly tilted back and to one side with chin raised high looking down the nose, physical superiority posture, long straight black hair flowing down her back, fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, fresh nude-pink manicure visible on hand resting on hip, pearl stud earrings, small gold locket at neckline, warm tungsten lamp from a low angle lighting her from below the chin creating slight horror-movie underlighting that emphasizes the smirk coldness, standing over seated husband, Chinese modern comic style, soft cinematic lighting, emotional weight
do_not_render: eyes crinkled in a real laugh (this is smirk, not joy)
soft flattering window light (would falsely warm her up)
a background full of warmth cues like flowers or pets — keep the frame cold
usage_note_for_step_4_5_6: 引用本表情时，Step 4/5/6 必须把 `prompt_snippet_en` 整体作为人物描述嵌入，并在面板说明里复述中文语义 '轻蔑'。注意：'轻蔑' 是妻子情绪光谱中最冷的一档，与 '生气' / '愤怒' 都不同——后两者至少还有情感投入，'轻蔑' 是情感退出。不得仅写文件名。
